metadata.description: Full outbound execution engine for B2B service companies: 21 skills covering deliverability, prospect-list research, hypotheses, sequence copy, reply handling, A/B testing and reporting.

plugins.name: outbound-engine
plugins.description: 21 Claude Code skills that execute the outbound block of a GTM system for B2B service companies (agencies, outsourcing, consulting): a router that works out which stage you are at and enforces the gate it depends on, signal and data-point research over an existing base, prospect-list research, waterfall enrichment, two-stage scoring (pre-contact and post-contact), hypothesis building, sequence copy (email + LinkedIn + subject lines + follow-ups + PS lines), campaign tiering/naming/orchestration, deliverability audit, A/B test analysis, campaign reports, weekly outreach report, per-reply objection handling and forensic reply audits. Built and battle-tested by Victor Shulga (Fractional CRO).
